title: System Python cannot validate Studio production schema because project dependency is not on the ambient interpreter
symptom: Direct /usr/bin/python3 validation failed with ModuleNotFoundError: jsonschema.
expected_behavior: Validation should use the repository's declared dependency environment.
actual_behavior: Ambient Python lacked jsonschema even though pyproject.toml and uv.lock pin jsonschema 4.25.1.
proposed_fix: Use the existing repository dependency entrypoint: /usr/bin/uv run python ...
fix_attempt: Repeated the same schema validation through uv run without installing new global packages.
verification: Validation returned production-schema:ok; the same job also decoded FLAC and OGG outputs successfully.
